'''Borstel Galactic Defense''' was a corporation that produced a variety of shipboard [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion]] and [[Laser/Legends|laser]] weaponry, [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]], as well as various [[Missile/Legends|missile]] systems. The company shared research and development facilities with [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Borstel was the company that produced the [[RG-9 laser cannon/Legends|RG-9]] model laser cannons for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]], the [["Shocklock" ranging laser]] turret used on [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets, and [[RH8 laser cannon/Legends|RH8 laser cannons]] that were the primary anti-starfighter weaponry onboard [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigates]].
